o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *kiarïnč-ɣa, from Proto-Turkic *karïnčga (“ant”). Doublet of qarınca. Cognate with Turkish karınca, Crimean Tatar qarınca, Turkmen garynja (“ant”).
From Persian سنگین (sangin, “heavy”). Doublet of zəngin.
From Tat nuhur or from Middle Mongol ᠨᠠᠭᠤᠷ (naɣur), whence also Mongolian нуур (nuur).
Borrowed from Arabic مَحْشَر (maḥšar). Compare also Turkish mahşer.
Izafet II compound of səs (“voice, sound”) + yazı (“text, writing”). Calque of Russian звукозапись (zvukozapisʹ).
